split_date_outside_window.reason: Membership is decided by the esearch [edat] filter. dates.split_date is the History entrez date, which can differ by one day at the window edges (time zone); items were kept as fetched.

found_by_esearch_but_not_downloaded.reason: efetch returns these as PubmedBookArticle (for example StatPearls book chapters); the shared fetcher parses PubmedArticle only, so they are skipped.
